name: RSE-Toolbag
author: notto0606, RSE contributors
description: A 10-slot toolbag beside the inventory (needs RSE-Dock). Shift+1-0 equips a slot, and the tool key takes out the right tool for what you face. Empty the toolbag before removing the mod.

settings.label: Toolbag slot keys
settings.tooltip: Hold this and press 1-0 to equip toolbag slot 1-10. NONE turns the keys off.

settings.label: Tool key
settings.tooltip: Face a rock, tree, farm plot or fishing spot and press it: the best tool comes out, toolbag first. Pick None to turn it off.

settings.label: Show equip prompt
settings.tooltip: Shows "[key] Equip <tool>" while you face something a tool you carry can work on.

settings.label: Rock and tree reach
settings.tooltip: How close a rock or tree must be, in front of you.

settings.label: Compost bucket for watered plots
settings.tooltip: On a watered farm plot the key takes out the compost bucket.

settings.label: Auto tool on hit
settings.tooltip: Hit a rock, tree or farm plot with the wrong item and the right tool comes out. Never from a bow, crossbow, staff, wand, seeds or potions.

settings.label: Also from melee weapons
settings.tooltip: Also swap away from melee weapons, but only for a rock or tree right in front of you.

settings.label: Pickups go to the bag first
settings.tooltip: Picked-up items go into your bag instead of filling empty hotbar slots. In co-op the host's setting decides.
